articles.title: Mysterious Object From Beyond Solar System May Be "Seed" Traveling Galaxy and Creating New Planets, Paper Finds
articles.summary: Astronomers were fascinated after spotting an object from interstellar space hurtling through the solar system earlier this summer. Since then, they've been racking their brains, trying to understand its unusual composition and exact origins. In a yet-to-be-peer-reviewed paper, an international team of researchers raised an intriguing possibility: objects like 3I/ATLAS could become the "seeds" of giant planets after being captured in the accretion discs made up of dust and gas surrounding a young star. "Interstellar objects may be able to jump-start planet formation, in particular around higher-mass stars," said Forschungszentrum Jülich in Germany
